description: Calculate transparent signup and conversion rates from the non-negative counts you provide. Returns an evidence-bounded result and the canonical web tool URL.

conversions.description: Optional number of signups who became paying customers, as a plain count. Leave out if unknown, and the paid conversion rate is reported as unknown.

signups.description: Number of those visitors who signed up, as a plain count. The signup rate is signups divided by visits.

visits.description: Number of tracked visits to your launch page in the measurement window, as a plain count.
